title: Startup Center — All-in-One Startup Incubation Ecosystem
subtitle: WebRTC Video Conferencing, Real-Time Messaging, Gamification & Multi-Cloud Architecture
summary: All-in-one ecosystem for early-stage founders featuring TokBox WebRTC video rooms, Pusher real-time chat, gamified StarCoin economy, PayPal billing, and IBM Bluemix-to-AWS multi-cloud migration.
overview: Startup Center was engineered as an all-in-one incubation ecosystem designed to foster collaboration, market validation, and growth for early-stage startups. The platform consolidated market validation surveys, real-time founder networking, internal gamified incentives, and third-party SaaS integrations, eliminating tooling fragmentation for founders. Acting as the solo software architect and engineer, I built the entire solution in Laravel, integrating WebRTC interactive video conferencing via TokBox, real-time messaging via Pusher, and PayPal checkout across an IBM Bluemix to AWS multi-cloud architecture.
responsibilities: Ecosystem Architecture: Designed the end-to-end layered architecture integrating multiple external real-time APIs.
StarCoffee Module: Built interactive virtual conference rooms with low-latency audio/video and chat via TokBox WebRTC and Pusher.
Gamification Engine: Programmed the platform internal economy tracking Seeder reputation points and StarCoin virtual balances.
Monetization & Multi-Cloud: Integrated PayPal Express Checkout workflows and provisioned cloud infrastructure on IBM Bluemix and AWS.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Orchestrating multiple asynchronous external real-time streams (TokBox WebRTC, Pusher WebSockets, and PayPal IPN) inside a unified reactive UI.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built decoupled adapter layers with an internal Laravel event bus to maintain seamless synchronized application state.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Migrating production live workloads from IBM Bluemix to AWS without service interruption.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Structured modular infrastructure scripts and executed progressive DNS routing cutover alongside replicated database syncing.
